VideoCut original synthetic Chinese and English reference voices — 2026-10-16
License reference: LicenseRef-VideoCut-Synthetic-Reference

Covered resources:
  videocut-original-mandarin-01.wav — Gentle Narration
  videocut-original-mandarin-02.wav — Steady Narration
  videocut-original-{zh,en}-{child,teen,young,middle,senior}-{female,male}.wav
    — 20 additional voices, one for each language / age group / gender combination.
  videocut-original-dongbei-{female,male}-{a,b}.wav
  videocut-original-sichuan-male-{a,b}.wav
    — 6 user-selected original regional-accent references, second-round A/B variants.
  Their authored reference transcripts in the voice catalog.

These 28 voices were generated locally from VideoCut-authored Chinese/English
text and generic voice descriptions. Age groups, regional accent and gender are synthetic design
targets, not claims about a real speaker. No real person's reference recording was
provided and no named person, actor or existing character was requested.
The presets are AI-generated voices, not recordings of consenting donors.

The references and transcripts are supplied for local voice synthesis in
VideoCut, including commercial and non-commercial generated media. VideoCut
may distribute them with the App and use them as Hojo reference inputs.
The project does not claim exclusive ownership of an abstract voice identity,
endorsement by Qwen or a real speaker, or rights in third-party inputs.
Normal App terms and applicable law continue to apply.

Authoring model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign
Model revision: 5ecdb67327fd37bb2e042aab12ff7391903235d3
Code: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS
Code revision: 022e286b98fbec7e1e916cb940cdf532cd9f488e
Model card:
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign/blob/5ecdb67327fd37bb2e042aab12ff7391903235d3/README.md

Qwen's model, tokenizer and code remain attributed third-party Apache-2.0
works. They are authoring tools and are not bundled in this App. Their model
license does not automatically license the resulting WAVs as Apache-2.0.
The applicable published licenses add no restriction on commercial output,
redistribution of output, or use as another model's inference reference.
This is the project's adoption decision, not a Qwen-specific endorsement.

The catalog's legacy consent_confirmed field records project authorization
for these synthetic references. human_speaker_consent is not_applicable;
there is no donor consent document and the donor evidence URL is empty.
Existing human-donor presets retain their separate donation evidence.

The App contains mono 16 kHz PCM16 derivatives and the authored input text.
Original-rate WAVs, recipes and generation logs accompany the separate source
materials. The user listened to and approved the six second-round accent clips.
No automated pronunciation/text-alignment checks or Hojo synthesis were run.
The regional label is a reference-voice design, not a guarantee of dialect
pronunciation or accent retention when Hojo synthesizes new text.
